name: Joker’s Million

features.name: Two scatter types
features.description: Blue and red scatters with different pay rules.

review:
Joker's Million is a 100-line fruit slot run by a ringmaster Joker. It features stacked symbols, expanding wilds and a classic gamble round.

Wilds appear only on reels 2 to 4, and when a wild completes a win it expands to cover the whole reel, possibly completing more wins. There are two scatter types: blue scatters pay for three to five anywhere, and red scatters have different conditions. BGaming rates the game medium-high volatility with a 3,000x maximum, and the RTP is an outstanding 97.34%. A strong-value pick for classic slot fans.
